description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'ConnectionFailedException' used within the Eclipse Ditto project to signal a failure in establishing a connection. It extends 'DittoRuntimeException' and implements 'ConnectivityException', and includes builder patterns for creating instances with various details.
